headline: For those who actually care.
sub: See when Gran was last visited. She doesn't need a phone.
content:
Most families care about their parents. Fewer can tell you when someone last sat with Mum.

That's not a character flaw. It's the gap between caring and knowing — and it's where the long silences come from. Nobody went, because everyone assumed someone else had.

GranWatch closes the gap with one shared ring. Anyone in the family can be the one who turns it green.

For those who actually care. granwatch.app
